+from datetime import date
+
+from bank import ledger
+from bank.money import Money
+
+
+def test_BENCH4_statement_closing_balance_matches_its_lines(conn, at):
+    account = ledger.open_account(conn, ledger.create_customer(conn, "Total Customer"), "EUR")
+    ledger.deposit(conn, account.id, Money.of("10.00", "EUR"), at=at("2026-03-01"))
+    ledger.deposit(conn, account.id, Money.of("5.50", "EUR"), at=at("2026-03-02"))
+    ledger.withdraw(conn, account.id, Money.of("2.25", "EUR"), at=at("2026-03-03"))
+    st = ledger.statement(conn, account.id, date(2026, 3, 1), date(2026, 3, 3))
+    assert len(st.lines) == 3
+    assert st.closing_minor == st.opening_minor + sum(line.amount_minor for line in st.lines)
